claims.statement: A draft letter offering skills in military engineering and noting his ability as painter and sculptor. Whether it was sent, and exactly when, is not known.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Codex Atlanticus; dating is an editorial estimate.
